list.name: Game Engine
list.description: Pure framework-free combat and music model in src/game — ATB tick loop, arrangement grids, music theory, QTE charts, and the session singleton.

list.name: Audio Renderer
list.description: Browser-only Tone.js renderer in src/audio that turns engine snapshots into pooled synth voices, Transport playback, live audition, and SFX.

list.name: UI Layer
list.description: React presentation for the Dark Room-style flow — screens, combat widgets, step sequencer, hooks, app entry, styles, and HTML shell.

list.name: State Bridge
list.description: Zustand mirror of the engine session plus guarded localStorage persistence wiring gameplay state to React and across reloads.

list.name: Game Data
list.description: Static balance and content definitions — enemies, encounters, chord presets, and the playable character roster.

list.name: Test Suite
list.description: Vitest coverage across the engine, data, persistence, state bridge, and component/integration screens using seeded RNG.

list.name: Build Configuration
list.description: Vite, TypeScript, oxlint, shadcn, and package-manifest settings that compile, lint, and test the project.

list.name: Documentation
list.description: Contributor guide, project overview, and combat/QTE design docs describing mechanics and roadmaps.
